card.name: Words before 'appropriate' or 'relevant'
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'appropriate' or 'relevant', most often 'initiate' after 'discontinue X and'. Also seen on words like 'molecular' and 'measures' in research or supportive-care phrases.

modes.label: Stop and initiate
modes.description: The verb 'initiate' after 'discontinue [drug] and', ahead of 'appropriate therapy'.
modes.example: discontinue meropenem for injection and<< initiate>> appropriate therapy. (5.3)

modes.label: Science nouns and adjectives
modes.description: Words like 'molecular' or 'structure' in research descriptions, where a field-related word may follow.
modes.example: evolving methods in<< molecular>> and cellular biology to elucidate the path

modes.label: Supportive care phrasing
modes.example: other appropriate signs should be monitored and general supportive<< measures>> employed.
